why_best: Commencing close on the action builds instant visual urgency before expanding to reveal the full macro system in a single cohesive breath.
why_bad: Using a flat 2D scale animation instead of a spatial perspective zoom destroys the dimensional weight and makes the close-up tracking feel artificial.
trap: A near-miss will lock the textual labels to the tilted background plane rather than keeping every data tag strictly upright and camera-facing.
